lines: I wasn't sure how long we had walked while avoiding and defeating enemies.
But man, this place is huge. I can't believe the UFS built a full-fledged base like this completely in secret.
All the more reason getting caught would be bad.
...Hm? Hey Fuma, looks like there's a large open area over here.
What do you mean, over here? No matter how you look at it, isn't that a wall? Are you tired, Shikanosuke-chan?
No, wait. This isn't a wall... it's a door!
Oooh...! Good work, Shikanosuke, there's a terminal.
There was a discreetly hidden door in the wall of the hallway, and behind it a room with rows and rows of terminals.
Without Shikanosuke we would have never noticed.
I'll try to get the data right away. You guys watch for enemies.
I approached one of the terminals and tried to access the network.
(Password protected. Well, I guess it would be...)
I hadn't expected accessing the terminal would be easy. But our client was an information broker.
(She called it the "gang hideout terminal access code" though...)
I entered the string of letters, hand-written on a note decorated with a gold butterfly.
I had gained access to the UFS network almost too easily.
(Hey, hey... this is an access code for the UFS network. Where did she get this? Who is that masked woman...)
But that could wait until later. I began downloading all available data onto a high-capacity storage device I had prepared.
(That's a lot of data. Looks like it's going to take some time.)
For some reason bright red letters began flooding the screen with English text.
(Security... buri... chi? Shit, this is what I get for always skipping English class...)
For now the data transfer seemed to be continuing, so we would just have to hold out until it was completed. I prayed while staring at the remaining time.
Fuma-chan, why is the screen bright red?
Hebiko noticed and came over, looking closely at the letters.
Security breach... unauthorized data transfer. "Unauthorized data transfer in progress, security has been notified."
Oooh, as expected of a top student.
This isn't the time to be impressed! The data transfer has been reported to security!
Wh-What happens once it's been reported??
Our enemies will be notified of this location. That means all enemies still left in the base will come rushing here.
Yeah, in the worst case we'll get cornered in here. Another... 5 minutes until the download completes.
Hebiko has a bad feeling about this.
Heeeey!! L-, l-l-let's get outta here already!!
We'll have to fight even if we run away. Get ready and defend this place until the data transfer is complete!!
I could hear the clamor of enemies starting to gather outside the room.
